system.description:
EXPERT

Knowing what you are hunting means you are rarely surprised when it finally appears.
Whenever you roll Initiative and at least one of your Studied Targets is participating in the encounter, you gain a +10-circumstance bonus to Initiative.
Furthermore, you may immediately Recall Knowledge concerning one participating Studied Target as a Free (0 AP) action.

Prerequisites Study Target, Perception 5 ranks

Works automatically: +10 circumstance to Initiative is offered with the book's wording; the free Recall Knowledge is a note.

conditionals.label: Prepared for Trouble
conditionals.scope: Initiative when at least one of your Studied Targets is in the encounter
